title: Asymmetric Braids in a Hologram City
summary: In a city defined by extrajudicial troopers and rancid vermouth, a lone teenager, marked by asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, navigates a world of flickering holograms and false utopias. She carries a cracked jade compass and a half-eaten jawbreaker, her spirit mirroring the infant trampling whistles. Awakened in a lanky labyrinth, her arachnophobia intensifies as she finds enlocked toys and cryptic scripting. With a sarcastic retrospective, she confronts runaways, feeling frantic and introspective, a violet goblet glowing faintly. Gripping a musket, she navigates roadblocks of bison statues, an unrecognisable wanderer on a chaotic boardwalk. Iced applejack and mustard hints at the elite presence as she privately observes. Finally, a blotched concrete dome emerges, a modular hatchery of new technology. An interpreter, a kindergartner with a monocle, and a vendor now populate the driveways, frankly offering a report on a kerfuffle. Her compass lies abandoned, a testament to psionic changes.
